name: keraies-v2
title: Registered Antennas Scraper (keraies.eett.gr) v2
description: Scrapes Greece's registered antenna registry (keraies.eett.gr): collects antennas per municipality, fetches full details (address, coordinates, company, permit status, documents), with pagination, concurrency control and pay-per-event monetization ($0.005 per antenna).
